facts.fact: Togo First, 18 November 2025, recalls that in December 2024 Togo launched two public data dissemination platforms, Open Data and the Geoportail Open Data, run by the Agence Togo Digital; it does not tie them to an open data policy.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Efficacité de l'action publique et de la Transformation numérique, with GIZ support

note: The article is about the ONN digital-sector observatory (class other); only its closing reference to the December 2024 portals gives a fact.
